dct_description_sm: CWWA has been monitoring water quality for over 20 years; we have followed the Province of New Brunswick’s methods for monitoring *B and E. Coli, installed data loggers to measure temperature, and established 23 long-term monitoring sites.  We attempt to sample every two years, and have selected a subset of 10 monitoring sites based on availability of funding for our work.
dct_title_s: Canaan-Washademoak Watershed Association Water Quality Dataset
